serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Cloud software-as-a-service for chemistry homework delivery, autograding, and instructor authoring, together with paid MyMol Plus, Premium, and Professional subscription entitlements on chemillusion.com and the MyMol native apps. **FedRAMP 20x Initial Implementation Phase Marketplace listing** (package ID FR2703160237, listed 2026-11-04) — a Marketplace listing is not FedRAMP authorization or certification. **Intended program target (not assessed or authorized):** Class B certification at **Low** system impact level. Certification is in process.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: FedRAMP-oriented trust center landing page (human-readable). Programmatic package overview JSON is served at /api/fedramp/certification-package-overview from the production API.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: Draft secure configuration and hardening guidance for administrators (in preparation; anchor on trust center until a standalone SCG is published).

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Information security, access control, backup/DR, change management, incident response, and vendor management policies (private repository; public summaries on trust center when enabled).
additionalRepositories.accessRequestInstructions: Email support@chemillusion.com from an agency or institutional domain. Policy sources are documented in this private repository path; additional public summaries may appear on the trust center over time.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Delivers assigned homework and quizzes, records attempts and scores, and surfaces feedback. **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Sources: student course routes in `frontend/src/App.tsx`; data handling in `docs/privacy/lms/student_lms_privacy_notice.md` (verified 2026-10-30).

Build and publish homework assignments and quizzes where the account holds the homework authoring entitlement. **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Sources: `frontend/src/config/homeworkCreatorAccess.ts`; backend enforcement required per file header (verified 2026-10-30).

Paid subscription sold as MyMol Plus (`basic` plan) with enhanced quotas and MyMol features per `docs/TIER_FEATURES.md`. **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Verified 2026-10-30 against `docs/TIER_FEATURES.md`.

Premium tier entitlements for MyMol and web surfaces inherited from lower tiers plus Premium-only capabilities documented in `docs/TIER_FEATURES.md`. **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Verified 2026-10-30.

Professional tier — owner-confirmed 2026-10-30 that "Pro" means this tier only; there is no separate Pro SKU (plan code `professional`). **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Sources: `docs/TIER_FEATURES.md`; owner confirmation 2026-10-30.

certifiedServices.serviceName: MyMol Android in-app purchases (Google Play Billing)
certifiedServices.serviceDescription: MyMol Plus sold inside the Android app via Google Play Billing 8, verified on Railway (`POST /api/mymol/store/verify`, `POST /api/webhooks/google-play`). **In assessment boundary — cannot be removed by hiding web UI.** **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Sources: `docs/runbooks/mymol-iap.md` (verified 2026-10-30).

Stripe checkout and subscription lifecycle on the web; Google Play Billing on MyMol Android; Apple App Store billing for MyMol iOS where enabled — ChemIllusion stores payment vendor metadata only (no card data on ChemIllusion systems). **FedRAMP security category (intended CSO target, not assessed):** Low. Sources: `soc2-compliance-evidence/policies/information-security-policy.md`; `docs/runbooks/mymol-iap.md`; `docs/privacy/subprocessors.md` (verified 2026-10-30).
